outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue images, not a summary plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot showing distributions (median, quartiles, min/max) of immune cell fractions, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the box plots for each group.
Panel C consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel D is a bar chart showing log2 fold change values for multiple genes with no individual data points, error bars, or replicate values overlaid to indicate variability underlying each bar.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a summary plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
